note: Reviewed CDB90 match 34, pinned revision e0b35ec4d798cec3bb4e6970c0f6bb7aa69e2f4c. CDB90 (CAA Database of Battles, Version 1990), tidy data maintained by Jeffrey B. Arnold. Original US Army Concepts Analysis Agency data; revised data licensed ODC-BY. Original force designations and strength interpretations are retained with each quantity. Each side is one aggregate force, including any coalition; its total is not allocated among members. Personnel casualties are not deaths. Source estimates and adjudged error margins are not statistical confidence intervals. Equipment and tactical movements are not established by this dataset. Match review: Sinsheim municipal history dates the complete battle to 16 June 1674 and names Caprara with Charles of Lorraine against Turenne. The source IMP ALLIED ARMY remains a local combined force. The French FR ARMY maps unambiguously to existing Kingdom of France Q70972, kind polity. The municipality itself notes divergent strength estimates. Identity review (defender; original CDB90 name IMP ALLIED ARMY): CDB IMP ALLIED ARMY / CAPARA is a combined army. The municipal history identifies both commanders; preserve the whole local total rather than assigning it solely to Q12548.
